metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 among up to 2048 seed-42 sampled nonpadding embeddings, excluding zero or nonfinite vectors. Isotropic embeddings are near 0.5. This measures directional alignment, not recommendation diversity, relevance, or user traits. Null if fewer than two usable vectors.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score from view.predict_score: the unscaled neural component only, excluding transition corrections. Valid positions require nonpadding source, positive and negative; nonfinite score pairs are excluded.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of the same neural margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of finite neural pairs with negative strictly above positive. Pairwise training evidence, not validation HR@10.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of finite neural margins below 0.5 in raw neural-score units; scale-dependent and not comparable to normalized deployed margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_tie_rate: Fraction of finite neural pairs with exactly equal scores; ties are reported separately.
metric_definitions.deployed_pos_neg_margins: Same mean, nearest-rank p10, strict negative-win, margin<0.5 and exact-tie statistics using score(features, items, source_items), with source_items=sequence at every B x L position. Uses the scorer's configured normalization, correction and alpha. Null values if no shared scorer or finite observations exist. Magnitudes depend on deployed scaling; these are not candidate-set ranks or HR@10.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Unavailable: item categories, ratings, reviews, prices and stores are not provided. No diversity or conformity traits are observed or inferred.

measurement_context.missing_values: Null denotes unavailable or empty evidence, never measured zero.
measurement_context.selection_metric: External pinned four-category macro validation HR@10 only.
measurement_context.rng_restoration: Python, NumPy global, Torch CPU and the selected CUDA device RNGs are restored. Loader-owned generators and worker state are not rewound; use a separate diagnostic loader when those are present.
measurement_context.research_scope: These probes measure the supplied model and optional shared scorer. They do not implement transition fitting, normalization, shared-alpha selection, predictor serialization, or validation attribution controls.
